negative_control.claim: gear_drop_pool() element ORDER cannot be safely externalized to JSON without a locking test
negative_control.why: the gear roll draws a pool INDEX and indexes positionally; JSON round-trips preserve value but not declared-order guarantees once tooling rewrites keys, sorts, or merges files - every elite/trash drop outcome would silently shift with zero type or unit failures
negative_control.required_before_externalization: byte-order locking test asserting pool contents AND order, plus a parity fixture rolling drops across all rarities/depths before and after the data move
